EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoExecutionTrace.description: Message that helps aggregate all sub-executions triggered by one execution and keeps track of child-parent relationships.

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoParameterValue.description: LINT.IfChange To support various types of parameter values. Next available id: 14

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetIntParamete.description: This message only contains a field of integer array.

ancestorIterationNumbers.description: Optional. Ancestor iteration number for the task (it will only be non-empty if the task is under 'private integration').

privateIntegrationName.description: Optional. The direct integration which the execution belongs to.

taskNumber.description: The task number associated with this execution.

task.description: The task name associated with this execution.

taskLabel.description: The task label associated with this execution.

executionAttempt.description: The execution attempt number this execution belongs to.

taskAttempt.description: The task attempt number this execution belongs to.

ancestorTaskNumbers.description: Optional. Ancestor task number for the task (it will only be non-empty if the task is under 'private integration').

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2TaskExecution.description: Execution of a single task within an integration

variables.description: Optional. Variables used during the execution.

taskExecutionMetadata.description: Optional. Metadata of the task execution.

customMessage.description: Optional information to provide recipients of the suspension in addition to the resolution URL, typically containing relevant parameter values from the originating workflow.

suspensionExpiration.description: Indicates the next steps when no external actions happen on the suspension.

whoMayResolve.description: Identities able to resolve this suspension.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetIntegration.description: Integration Parameter is defined in the integration config and are used to provide information about data types of the expected parameters and provide any default values if needed. They can also be used to add custom attributes. These are static in nature and should not be used for dynamic event definition.

displayName.description: The name (without prefix) to be displayed in the UI for this parameter. E.g. if the key is "foo.bar.myName", then the name would be "myName".

enumDescriptions: Input parameters for the integration. EventBus validates that these parameters exist in the integrations before execution.
Output Parameters for the integration. EventBus will only return the integration parameters tagged with OUT in the response back.

Input and Output Parameters. These can be used as both input and output. EventBus will validate for the existence of these parameters before execution and will also return this parameter back in the response.
inputOutputType.description: Specifies the input/output type for the parameter.

defaultValue.description: Default values for the defined keys. Each value can either be string, int, double or any proto message or a serialized object.

jsonSchema.description: This schema will be used to validate runtime JSON-typed values of this parameter.

isTransient.description: Whether this parameter is a transient parameter.

key.description: Key is used to retrieve the corresponding parameter value. This should be unique for a given fired event. These parameters must be predefined in the integration definition.

keyName.description: A Cloud KMS key is a named object containing one or more key versions, along with metadata for the key. A key exists on exactly one key ring tied to a specific location.

keyRingName.description: A key ring organizes keys in a specific Google Cloud location and allows you to manage access control on groups of keys. A key ring's name does not need to be unique across a Google Cloud project, but must be unique within a given location.

locationName.description: Location name of the key ring, e.g. "us-west1".

serviceAccount.description: Optional. The service account used for authentication of this KMS key. If this is not provided, the service account in Client.clientSource will be used.

keyVersionName.description: Optional. Each version of a key contains key material used for encryption or signing. A key's version is represented by an integer, starting at 1. To decrypt data or verify a signature, you must use the same key version that was used to encrypt or sign the data.

gcpProjectId.description: Optional. The id of GCP project where the KMS key is stored. If not provided, assume the key is stored in the same GCP project defined in Client (tag 14).

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetGenerateJav.description: Response message containing generated Javascript code recommendations.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetEventParame.description: This message is used for processing and persisting (when applicable) key value pair parameters for each event in the event bus.

key.description: Key is used to retrieve the corresponding parameter value. This should be unique for a given fired event. These parameters must be predefined in the integration definition.

value.description: Values for the defined keys. Each value can either be string, int, double or any proto message.
